measurementRules.rule: Use 1 kg whole supplied net actual round tablets; exclude tare and collect cp_product once at the fixed first acceptance gate. No N-equivalent, dry-urea or dispatch denominator.

Record supplied wet whole material, actual urea/water/traces and each real phase separately. Volume/count conversion uses measured same-grade density/state or representative item mass; no source tablet weight or size default.

Preserve the actual native electricity reference property and unit; convert measured electrical kWh by3.6 MJ/kWh only. Match actual provider, voltage, delivery and losses; no fuel or intensity inference.
Weigh one actual whole contaminated export, including retained urea/water/lubricant; substrate/tare is nested and reconciled independently, not the whole waste amount or an extra companion exchange.
All amounts are per 1 kg reference flow. Divide each non-overlapping attributable numerator by positive locked Q; keep full physical totals separately and use original Q0 for later cohort services.

calculationRules.rule: Divide each non-overlapping attributable campaign exchange by positive locked Q to report per 1 kg reference flow; retain actual physical totals and original Q0 for later services.
calculationRules.output: individual original row unit per 1 kg reference flow

calculationRules.rule: Q is the sum of unique first-acceptance net masses; original Q0 equals disjoint net remaining deliveries plus all onsite accepted states, irreversible losses and other terminal dispositions on original basis, with later additions separately removed. No loop or restored loss increases Q.
calculationRules.output: locked Q and original-cohort disposition residual

calculationRules.rule: Opening physical stocks + actual external inputs = closing stocks + actual physical external outputs; paired internal transfers cancel. Conserve whole wet material, actual C/H/N/O, impurities/metal and water phases independently of burden allocation; use actual G/C for any real transformation and require route review. Whole-waste components and PM constituents remain nested, not extra flows.

Own inherited foreground/WIP vector + disjoint new work/upstream vectors = closing carried vectors + terminal attributed vectors. Preserve cohort cuts; either a provider aggregate or its verified non-overlapping decomposition, never both.

Electrical MJ = measured kWh ×3.6; this only matches the selected native NCV/MJ reference. Reconcile actual material-state/work/stock energy and independently supported heat, without forcing an unknown residual into heat_air.
calculationRules.output: matched electricity and separately evidenced energy balance

calculationRules.rule: Integrate actual compatible concentration multiplied by gas volume-flow rate over time; use complete blank/recovery/leak/gas-state corrections from the applicable method. Sum only disjoint actual outlets and independently established fugitive loads. PM mass and its measured urea/N/water remain one exchange plus nested analytical evidence.
calculationRules.output: actual atmospheric particulate kg and coverage gaps

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: Verify actual whole-product/component type, CAS, form, composition, native restriction and genuine provider property/unit. Actual additive-free round-tablet admission and classification-inference limits are mandatory; a category tag is insufficient.
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: full native records; supplier synthesis/grade and actual form/acceptance evidence

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: Require positive locked Q with unique events and complete original-basis postgate closure; raw/WIP/FG/returns/assets and inherited burden records cover the same declared scope. Unknown Q preserves raw totals without a complete normalized result.

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: Retain complete actual sampling, sample preservation and method/version/units with calibration, blanks, recovery and uncertainty for the actual urea/moisture/residue matrix. Do not infer grade, a dry-mass conversion or PM applicability from the IFDC example, native formula or a finite check. Unknown essential procedure blocks complete applicable data.
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: actual complete lab procedure/results; representative samples; matrix and method-scope evidence

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: Preserve whole actual exports and nested contamination independently from substrate fleet/tare and supplier service demand. No phantom separated powder stream, default life, double treatment or automatic recovery credit.
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: cp_pack; cp_asset; whole-versus-nested mass and receiver audit

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: Prove actual source/matrix applicability and complete outlet coverage; actual provider and state/units must match. Temperature, droplets/saturation, induced change or gas-geometry conflicts require another reviewed suitable procedure; unmeasured water/energy/air pathways are not zero or forced closure.
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: cp_air; cp_power; cp_water; full methods/dependencies and actual meter/state tests

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: Cover startup, normal production, idle, rework, sampling, cleaning, maintenance, packing/loading and actual abnormal losses throughout one continuous representative interval. Missing actual UUID/provider/amount remains disclosed; source-method defects and scientific/study qualification cannot be replaced by a successful mechanical check.
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: all nine protocols; complete actual PFD; operating and sampling coverage; explicit non-use and gap records

measurementRules.rule: 以固定首次验收门真实圆片整品供货净质量1千克为基准，排除皮重并以cp_product采集一次；不以氮当量、干尿素或发运量作分母。
分别记录供货湿基整品、实际尿素水杂质及每个真实相；体积件数转换须同等级实测密度状态或代表单件质量，不采用来源片重片径默认值。
保留真实原生电力参考属性单位，仅按3.6 MJ/kWh换算实测电量；匹配实际供方电压交付损耗，不推断燃料或强度。
一次称量真实整股受污染外运，包括滞留尿素水润滑剂；基材皮重为嵌套分账且独立核对，不等于整废物量，也不增加伴随交换。
所有数量均为每1千克参考流；各不重叠归属分子除以正且锁定Q，完整实物总量另留，后续批群服务沿用原Q0。

calculationRules.rule: 将各不重叠归属生产期交换除以正且锁定Q，报告每1千克参考流；保留实际实物总量，后续服务保留原Q0。
calculationRules.output: 逐项原行单位每1千克参考流

calculationRules.rule: Q为唯一首次验收净质量之和；原Q0等于原基准互斥净剩余交付、全部场内验收状态、不可逆损失和其他终端处置，后续新增另扣；循环或恢复损失不增加Q。
calculationRules.output: 锁定Q及原批群处置残差

calculationRules.rule: 期初实物库存加真实外部投入等于期末库存加真实外部输出，成对内部转移抵消。整湿物料、实际C/H/N/O、杂质金属及水相独立于负荷分配守恒；真实转化采用真实生成消耗并复审路线。整废物组分和PM组分保持嵌套，不增加流。
calculationRules.output: 带不确定度的未分配整品组分元素相态残差

calculationRules.rule: 自有继承前景在制向量加互斥新工作及上游向量等于期末结转向量加终端归属向量；保留批群切口，供方汇总量或其经验证不重叠拆分择一，不叠加。
电力MJ等于实测千瓦时乘3.6，仅用于匹配选定原生净热值/MJ参考。核对真实物料状态功和库存能量及有独立依据的热，不将未知差额强填heat_air。
calculationRules.output: 匹配电力及有独立证据的能量账

calculationRules.rule: 将真实同基准浓度乘气体体积流量对时间积分，采用适用方法完整空白回收漏气状态校正。仅汇总互不重叠真实排口和独立确认无组织负荷；PM质量及其中实测尿素氮水为一个交换及嵌套分析证据。
calculationRules.output: 真实大气颗粒物千克及覆盖缺口

collectionProtocols.temporal_coverage: 生产期内生产待机储存清洁装车
collectionProtocols.site_scope: 全部真实环境出口；捕集另记
collectionProtocols.quality_evidence: 完整方法版本依赖；尿素回收和相态试验；空白校准漏气；覆盖；真实介质；PM和组分不重复

collectionProtocols.raw_fields: 界面方向；实测水分时间状态；原料在制成品部件残渣水；实际空气湿度温压气流；吸放水；不确定度；原批群归属
collectionProtocols.collection_method: 代表性密封取样，采用有空白回收和不确定度的完整真实适用水分程序；用独立空气水交换证据核对相态库存，保留差额，不制造吸水蒸发来闭合。
collectionProtocols.frequency: 每批状态及代表性环境时段
collectionProtocols.temporal_coverage: 同一生产期及原验收批群
collectionProtocols.site_scope: 真实原料在制成品粉尘部件及大气界面
collectionProtocols.quality_evidence: 样品保存；方法范围版本；校准回收；湿度状态证据；无隐藏水或干质量恢复

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 核对真实整品组分类型、CAS、形态组成、原生限制及真实供方属性单位。必须满足真实无添加圆片准入及分类推断限制，仅分类标签不足。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: 完整原生记录；供方合成等级及真实形态验收证据

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 要求正且锁定Q、唯一事件和完整原基准验收后闭合，原料在制成品退货资产及继承负荷须同声明范围；Q未知则保留原总量，不形成完整归一化结果。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: cp_product；全部实物负荷账；父链事件审核

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 保留真实尿素水分残渣基质的完整实际采样保存、方法版本单位和校准空白回收不确定度；不从IFDC案例、原生分子式或有限检查推断等级、干质量换算或PM适用性。必要程序未知时阻止完整适用数据。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: 真实完整实验程序结果；代表样；基质与方法范围证据

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 整股真实外运及嵌套污染与基材实物群皮重和供方服务需求分别保留；不设虚构分离粉体、默认寿命、重复处理或自动回收抵扣。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: cp_pack；cp_asset；整股嵌套质量及接收审核

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 证明真实源基质适用性及完整出口覆盖，匹配真实供方状态单位。温度液滴饱和诱发变化或气道几何冲突须采用另行审查适用程序；未测水能量空气路径不为零，也不强行闭合。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: cp_air；cp_power；cp_water；完整方法依赖和真实表计状态试验

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 覆盖连续代表时段的开机正常生产待机返工取样清洁维护包装装车及真实异常损失。实际UUID供方数量缺失须披露，来源方法缺陷及科学研究资格不能以机械检查成功替代。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: 九项协议；完整真实流程图；运行取样覆盖；明确未用与缺口记录
